title: Uniqueness of block coordinates
statement: For $N\in\mathbb{N}$, integers $z,z'$, and offsets $j,j'\in\{0,\ldots,N\}$, the positions $(N+1)z+j$ and $(N+1)z'+j'$ are equal if and only if $z=z'$ and $j=j'$.
replaced:
For $N \in \mathbb{N}$, $z, z' \in \mathbb{Z}$, and $j, j' \in \{0,\dots,N\}$, one has
$(N+1)z + j = (N+1)z' + j'$ if and only if $z = z'$ and $j = j'$.
